nodes.description: string public name token name storage
string public symbol token symbol storage
uint8 public decimals token decimals storage
uint256 public _totalSupply total token supply storage
mapping(address=>uint) balances ledger of token holders
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowed ERC20 allowance ledger
constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and minting entire supply to msg.sender
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) returns balances[tokenOwner]
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approve(address spender, uint tokens) overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval
transfer(address to, uint tokens) debits msg.sender and credits to using safeSub/safeAdd
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) debits from and the msg.sender allowance, credits to
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) checked addition with overflow require
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) checked subtraction with underflow require
msg.sender attacker controlled caller address
unchecked uint256 subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] performed without SafeMath
state mutation of balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] inside transfer
state mutation of balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to] inside transferFrom
unconditional overwrite of allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve enabling allowance race
tokenOwner address parameter of balanceOf
tokenOwner address parameter of allowance
spender address parameter of allowance
spender address parameter of approve
tokens uint parameter of approve
to address parameter of transfer
tokens uint parameter of transfer
from address parameter of transferFrom
to address parameter of transferFrom
tokens uint parameter of transferFrom

edges.reason: msg.sender is the deployer that receives the entire initial supply in the constructor
approve keys the allowance write on the caller controlled msg.sender
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] determined by the caller
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender] determined by the caller
constructor assigns the fixed _totalSupply value
constructor mints the total supply into balances[msg.sender]
constructor writes name state variable
constructor writes symbol state variable
constructor writes decimals state variable
totalSupply reads _totalSupply as the minuend of an unchecked subtraction
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] without any underflow guard
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry
allowance returns the allowed mapping entry
approve writes the allowed mapping
transfer writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient
transferFrom writes the balances mapping for from and to
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping of the caller
transfer relies on safeSub for the sender balance debit
transfer relies on safeAdd for the recipient balance credit
transferFrom relies on safeSub for balance and allowance debits
transferFrom relies on safeAdd for the recipient balance credit
_totalSupply is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply
balances[address(0)] is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply
totalSupply contains the raw unchecked subtraction operation
transfer contains the balance state mutation marked as unsafe operation
transferFrom contains the balance and allowance state mutation marked as unsafe operation
approve contains the unconditional allowance overwrite marked as unsafe operation
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance
spender parameter is the key of the allowance written in approve
tokens parameter is the allowance value written in approve
to parameter is the credited account in transfer
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transfer
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom
